new_local_feedback.source: user-delegated existing-log review summary, explicitly clarified by the user and received through root agent
new_local_feedback.observation: All three existing e4 traces reportedly contain neither zero-dimension drawing errors nor Render error records; this is explicit absence, not only absence of a flood.

source_findings.native_view: Single native forward per owner invocation; view count need not equal presentation count.
source_findings.classifier: Large-queue two local HashSets per reroute; capacity-shortage preflight can add two, with allocation-failure fallback. Existing optimization avoids repeated linear scans. Runtime frequency/cost unmeasured.
source_findings.constant_cache: 32 fixed payload slots of4096 bytes; epoch clear and stack item scratch, with native fallback behind eligibility/ownership/environment gates.
source_findings.activation: Addon disk/hash validation at first admitted EMF activation; shader snapshot/disassembly/registry allocation at shader construction, not each draw.
source_findings.overlay: Valid-viewport backend creates RTV each render pass, uploads3buffer streams and submits each nonempty clipped element DrawIndexed. CPU vectors retain capacity and CreateBuffer recurs only on capacity growth.
source_findings.diagnostic_boundary: SCBL_VISION_CAUSAL_BUILD=1 disables reuse; production clears it. Sampled view/call CPU wall times are not presented-frame/GPU samples.

actual_offline_cache_allocation_probe.measurement_scope: Unchanged pure production cache construction/clear/insert/lookup only; no native adapter, D3D resource, shader registry or classifier allocation measured.

measurement_plan.initial_control: Same-build A/A quartet with EMF off/on; repetitions separate.
measurement_plan.comparison: Exact baseline/modified builds and same machine/scene/settings/addons/capture, same positive viewport; paired four-cell minimum100frames percell.
measurement_plan.cold_and_resize: Preserve complete runs and first-use/resize/zero intervals; separate predeclared steady-state windows without hidden stall removal.
measurement_plan.metrics: One of present_interval_ms,cpu_frame_ms,gpu_frame_ms perdocument. Native view/upload/draw counts and sampled CPU segments never substituted for frames.

conclusion: Confirmed source work sites and narrow allocation observation; actual EMF slowdown remains needs-triage and matched frame input needs-info.
